interface.title: qPilot Studio
interface.field: Molecular biology / gene-expression analysis (real-time qPCR, RDML)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis of raw instrument output, through statistical conclusions, to export for publication graphs (GraphPad Prism)
interface.what_it_is_for: Takes a raw qPCR RDML export through a blinded, staged review: confirm the design, then the curve calls, then decide the analysis choices that change conclusions (with reasons), then send an audited, Prism-ready bundle and read back edits made in Prism.

data.note: Pressed Open with no file, which loaded the cached demo data_vermeulen_raw.rdml (Vermeulen neuroblastoma set: 427 samples, 66 targets, 3 technical plates plus 64 biomarker plates). Model provider was 'none', so only fixed rules made proposals. Partway through, the browser tab crashed and the screenshot counter restarted at 001, overwriting the first run's images. Pressing Open again resumed the saved session ('continues where it was left… every decision already made is kept'). Every screen cited from screens/ comes from the second run. Most Design-stage work (typing the experiment description, proposing the design, the reject, the bulk accept, the JSON edit, the Design confirm) was done in the first run, and no screen of it survives. Those steps appear here only through their entries in the 'Decided in this stage' log or the stage tracker. Screens under check/screens/ come from the replay agent, which found the resumed session already finished.

tree.specific: Take the Vermeulen RDML from intake through Design, Curves, Choices, Prism draft and Round trip in qPilot Studio. The Studio page does not cover exporting or verifying the hash-chained Analysis Record. That step is outside the page and was not done.

features.name: Proposal card with engine check and reasoned accept/reject/edit
features.general: Review a machine-made proposal: see its alternative readings, evidence, automatic consistency check and confidence; then accept it, reject it with a reason, or edit its values and accept. A contradicted proposal needs a reason to accept.
features.specific: Six-part card (Proposal, Why, Engine check with rule table such as D-SERIES/D-REP/D-COVER, Consequence, Level, Actions), with a Reason box and the buttons Accept, Reject, Does this matter? and Edit, then accept (a JSON payload editor). Kept screens show the curve call-rule card and the prism.project card. The reject, contradicted-accept and JSON-edit paths were used in the first run only.
steps: read the proposal and its other readings
check the engine verdict (consistent / contradicted / cannot check)
type a reason when one is needed
press Accept or Reject, or open Edit, then accept, change the payload and press Accept with these edits
the decision moves to 'Decided in this stage'
serves_tasks: Decide which wells count as amplified
Draft and approve the export project

features.name: Bulk accept of checked-consistent proposals, with a preview
features.general: Accept all proposals that passed the automatic check at once, after seeing exactly which ones; failed or uncheckable ones stay for individual review
features.specific: 'Accept all consistent…' lists the proposals it will accept, each tagged consistent with its id, then 'Accept these N' or Cancel. Contradicted and cannot-check proposals are never included. The 121-item Design preview was used in the first run and has no surviving screen. The replay shows only the empty case ('No waiting proposal of this stage is consistent…').
steps: press Accept all consistent…
scroll the preview list
press Accept these N or Cancel
the remaining contradicted items stay in the inbox

features.name: Staged workflow gate with stage tracker and hidden results
features.general: Move a review through ordered stages. Each stage locks only after an explicit confirmation that lists what it covers. Results stay hidden behind a panel until the earlier blind stages are locked.
features.specific: Stage tracker (Design (blind) → Curves (blind) → Choices → Prism draft → Round trip, with ✓/●/○ and counts waiting); a 'Results stay hidden' panel until the blind stages are confirmed; the 'Confirm this stage…' dialog shows the design hash, analysis id and decision-chain hash, the list of covered proposals, and 'Yes, confirm' or 'Not yet' with a reason; an Inbox of stage radio to revisit any stage
steps: decide every proposal in the stage
press Confirm this stage…
review the covered list and hashes
press Yes, confirm, or Not yet with a reason
the next stage opens in the tracker and inbox
serves_tasks: Decide which wells count as amplified
Review every recorded decision and whether it was accepted or rejected

features.name: Decision Card with per-option consequence table
features.general: For an analysis choice that can flip conclusions, show how many conclusions change and a table of each option's effect on the key results, then record the person's chosen option and reason
features.specific: Decision Cards (reference set, group cut-off, amplification call, undetermined wells): 'N of 58 conclusions change', an Option × gene fold-change/call table with recommended and 'not recommended (MIQE)' tags, a 'Your choice' radio, a required Reason, and Decide; a Card dropdown shows decided or auto-decided status
steps: pick a card in the Card dropdown
read the explanation and the option-by-gene table
choose an option and type a reason
press Decide; the card is marked 'Decided by human' and the next card opens
the export choice table shows 'a person' as the decider
serves_tasks: Decide each conclusion-changing choice, with a typed reason

features.name: Robustness (multiverse) summary bars and route comparison
features.general: Recompute every conclusion under all reasonable combinations of analysis choices and show, per item, how often its conclusion holds; also compare against common alternative pipelines and list which items flip
features.specific: 'Every conclusion was recomputed under 744 reasonable analyses' with a 'holds in X% of 744' bar per gene (ODC1 100 %, BIRC5 100 %, NTRK1 84 %, NM23A 65 %), plus 'Why the bridge matters' showing how many of 58 conclusions the Excel→Prism Welch (14), Student (21) and efficiency-2.0 (4) routes change, each with an expandable 'which' list
steps: confirm the blind stages so results unlock
read the per-gene hold-rate bars
expand 'which' under an alternative route to see the affected genes
serves_tasks: Review how robust each conclusion is across all reasonable analyses

features.name: Export preview, send and download of a self-describing bundle
features.general: Preview what will be exported (test, scale, groups, tables, choices and who decided them, caption), then write and download a bundle that carries its own provenance
features.specific: Prism preview tables, the choice table with deciders, a caption and a 'Would write' file list; Send to Prism (writes CSVs, run.pzc, send_back.pzc, README, qpilot_provenance.json, bundle JSON) and Download the bundle (.zip)
steps: draft and accept the Prism project
read the preview tables, choices and caption
press Send to Prism
press Download the bundle (.zip)
serves_tasks: Draft and approve the export project
Write and download the export bundle

features.name: Round-trip difference reader
features.general: After the exported tables were edited in another tool, point at the returned folder and list what changed since export, raising a question for each exclusion or changed value
features.specific: Round trip: 'Bundle sent from this page' dropdown plus a 'Folder the tables came back to' path box, then 'Read what changed in Prism'; differences become questions in the Round trip inbox
steps: choose the sent bundle
type the sent_back folder path
press Read what changed in Prism
decide any questions in the Round trip inbox
serves_tasks: Read back edits made in the external tool

features.name: Per-item result graph preview
features.general: Before exporting, view an approximate graph of one item's values per biological unit, with group means and confidence intervals, and show or hide groups
features.specific: 'Graph of' gene dropdown above a Plotly scatter of log2 RQ per biological unit with mean and 95 % CI; clicking a legend entry hides that group (Plotly zoom/pan/PNG toolbar present)
steps: choose a gene in Graph of
read the per-unit points with mean and CI
click a legend entry to hide or show a group

features.name: Numbers linked to their source facts
features.general: Every key number on the page is marked as traceable; hovering it reveals the id of the computed fact it came from, so any figure in a summary can be audited
features.specific: Dotted-underlined counts (such as the route 'N of 58' counts) whose hover tooltip shows a fact id, for example f_n_differ_route_linear_welch
steps: find a dotted-underlined number
hover it
read the fact id in the tooltip
serves_tasks: Review how robust each conclusion is across all reasonable analyses

features.name: What the model saw
features.general: For any stage, show exactly what was sent to the automated proposer, so a reviewer can tell what information a proposal could have been based on
features.specific: 'What the model saw' button beside a stage's inbox; with the model provider set to 'none' it reports 'No model call yet'
steps: choose a stage in Inbox of stage
press What the model saw
read the payload sent, or 'No model call yet'
serves_tasks: Review every recorded decision and whether it was accepted or rejected
